items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: Pat Cooper played bass for him. At the Grand, he plays with the accordionist who also played with me at various times.

ctx.x: You said it was a Cooper fella at the Grand Hotel? Oh boy. Yeah.

Pat Cooper played bass for him. At the Grand, he plays with the accordionist who also played with me at various times. Of course in my career of over 40 years as a leader I had a lot of different musicians, but always had the best I hope. Some of whom maybe were not considered the best by some other man leaders who were ignorant. They didn't know that you had to have a man who could play a floor show, you know? I played for Dick Shawn, I didn't know him for Madame, he throws me the books. I say Dick Shawn, well…
